find: It will: exist as a diatomic molecule, form −1 ions, be less reactive than chlorine (which has configuration 2, 8, 7 at period 3 — wait, that IS chlorine: 17 electrons). For a period-4 halogen (e.g. bromine, 2, 8, 18, 7), it would be less reactive than chlorine for the reason above.
